text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while walking through town...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hup... It's nice and light! Haah... How 
about this!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What do you think? Maybe it's okay 
to take a break from the bubbly vibe for a 
bit~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaah, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hello~. We were just thinking about a 
present for Maruzen-san♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Maruzen-san's talk show 
event, "Hippare☆Talkin'♪", is coming up 
right after this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, today marks the 134th 
time this hugely popular event has been 
held! By the way, it's the 4th time at 
this venue—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And so, we were invited! And Chiyono O 
said she wanted to give a present as a 
thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I'm with Curren-san, we could 
give them something great! Umastagram is 
super helpful, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thank you very much♪ Though to 
Curren, it's less of a "good thing" and 
more—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhhh?!?! It's Chiyo-chan and 
Curren-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since Chiyono O-san is here... could it be 
that you're going to Maruzen-san's event?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Are you and the others going 
too, Spe-san?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Before that, though, I came to look 
for some refreshments for Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I felt the exact same way~! This shop just 
screams "Maruzen-san," doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But... won't we all end up giving her 
something similar?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then instead of something 'like' 
Maruzen-san, how about picking what you 
actually want to give her?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Something to give... Something I want to 
give...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know what it is~~~~!! It's 
croquettes~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that something you want to 
deep-fry?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still... in that case, I want Maruzen-san 
to try some delicious food from my 
hometown too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-san, wait for me! The Hokkaido 
Fair~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I-In the blink of an eye...! Everyone had 
things on their minds after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You too, right, Chiyono O-san? Let's just 
pick whatever *we* want to give!♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~~~...! Talk about a high bar...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's THE Maruzen-san, you know? To think 
someone like me could pick something that 
makes her happy...
choice_data_list: What kind of girl is Maruzensky?

The answer might already be in the 
Chiyo-Note.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Does Maruzen-san really rank gifts or 
pick favorites?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! I won't—I definitely won't wear it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They were so kind to someone like me, and 
even when it came to gifts... they truly 
valued my desire to give them something, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So... I've decided! I'm going to give you 
what I truly want to give!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you really do have some~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! There's something I've been wanting 
to give you for a long time, if you'd be 
happy to have it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was holding back, thinking it'd be 
presumptuous of me, but... I'm gonna take 
on the challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Oh, this is... A cherry blossom keychain?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! It has a Japanese-style 
decorative cord, so I thought it looked 
cute...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, and well... I actually have the exact 
same one...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?! Then we're matching~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry for doing this without asking! 
If it creeps you out, please throw it 
away--!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course I won't throw it away. 
Your feelings make me so happy, 
Chiyo-chan! Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...She doesn't seem to realize it herself, 
but Chiyono O is quite the passionate one, 
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Chiyono O was able to 
successfully hand over the present to her 
idol.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah...?! That's so true, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"In a recent interview, Maruzen-san talked 
about how she's been doing lately...! 
Maybe there's a hint about what she 
wants!?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, amazing! It's packed with 
writing...! Is all of this about 
Maruzen-san?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I take notes on any parts that I 
think are important.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heh~... It's so packed full, it's 
practically the entire text copied down, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's just how it turns out~ ...Oh! Found 
it! The latest issue of "Monthly Tremdi"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... "Thanks for your hard 
work," "Rome in Atami," "Clumsy spill," 
"Urban massage chair"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Um, is this a cipher?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! The answer derived from this 
is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, a bath salts set?! Thank youuu~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"My body has been so stiff lately~, I was 
just wishing for some relaxation~! I'm 
sooo happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...♪ I'm so happy you like it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... But the thing that heals me the 
most is your smile, Chiyo-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! W-Waaah... No way, wow.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...You really watch me closely, don't 
you? Thank you, really."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!
